definition.attach: LivingState gains an optional sc_bridge field (default None); attach_bridge replaces the state with the table, clear_bridge removes it
definition.read: bridge_read delegates to table.read_sentence; with no table it returns decision=no_bridge and no answers
definition.read_side: attach, read and correct must not change any parameter, h, fast, nu_ema, coverage, prior, sc_sfk or the closed-state flags
definition.correction: one correction through the attached table changes the alias to RED; the table digest moves, the subject hashes do not
definition.clear: clear_bridge returns sc_bridge to None and bridge_read answers no_bridge
definition.handback: the table exported after the correction is imported into a fresh state and attached; it reads RED and 40/40
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.attach: sc_bridge is the same object; 20 describe sentences at 40/40; zeros 0/0; parameter and state hashes equal to the baseline
criteria.correction: table digest changes; alias reads RED; parameter and state hashes still equal; 40/40
criteria.clear: sc_bridge is None; bridge_read decision is no_bridge; state hash equals the baseline
criteria.handback: imported table digest equals the corrected table; attached read is RED; 40/40; 0/0
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.reporting: the bridge is a Python side table; the report keeps table digest, parameter hash and state hash in separate columns so 'no tensor moved' is visible
